metadata.agent_last_message:
The IGES tool is complete and working. Summary of what was built:

**Files (all in `/workspace/output/`):**
- `CMakeLists.txt` — C++20 build config, no external dependencies
- `src/main.cpp` — Entry point
- `src/cli.{hpp,cpp}` — CLI argument parsing and subcommand dispatch
- `src/iges.hpp` — Core types and 87 entity-specific data structs
- `src/iges_file.{hpp,cpp}` — 80-column section reader/writer, Hollerith codec, PD token stream
- `src/entities.{hpp,cpp}` — Per-entity PD parse/emit dispatch (all 87 types) + parse_iges/write_iges
- `src/serialize.{hpp,cpp}` — Canonical IGES-JSON ↔ in-memory model
- `src/eval.{hpp,cpp}` — Curve and surface parametric evaluation, transformation matrix chaining
- `src/json.{hpp,cpp}` — Minimal stdlib-only JSON parser/writer

**Verified working:**
- 5 subcommands: `parse`, `write`, `query`, `eval`, `roundtrip`
- Parse → JSON → roundtrip → byte-identical fixed point
- Curve eval (Line, Circular Arc, Conic, Composite, Copious Data, Spline, NURBS, Offset)
- Surface eval (Spline, Ruled, Revolution, Tabulated, NURBS, Offset, all 5 analytics)
- Validation: missing sections, negative entity types, zero param_line_count, degenerate Lines, invalid DE cross-refs (xform_matrix, view, label_display), non-positive Global numerics, prohibited delimiters, bad query DE, non-parametric eval target
- Error JSON envelope with `error`, `spec_ref`, `line`, `section`, `diagnostics` fields; field-name substrings for machine distinguishability
- Spec-version clamping (`>11` → 11) on parse
- Form-dependent entities (190/192/194/196/198, 218, 222, 304, 322, 404, 410, 416)
